title: Monitor Overconfidence Under Capability Gaps: Weak Monitors on Strong Agents

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Distinguishing between uncertain failures (can trigger escalation) and confident failures (dangerous) is directly actionable for monitoring architecture. Builds on weak-to-strong monitoring literature with a specific, practical question.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Setting up weak monitor / strong agent pairs requires API access to multiple models and SHADE-Arena integration. Measuring calibration on false negatives requires careful analysis. Designing a calibration-aware monitor adds complexity. Feasible but needs guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Core experiment (measure confidence on false negatives) is focused, but adding the calibration-aware monitor variant expands scope. Could be tightened by dropping the calibration-aware variant. Feasible within 30 hours if narrowed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
